line.text: status: approved   # by the operator, 2026-11-25: "approve 139–143 as recommended, waive §1.3". The words are the operator's, as relayed by the coordinating session to the architect agent that wrote this line; the approval takes effect when the operator merges the pull request that carries it. "As recommended" settles every open decision of section 8 at its recommended value. "waive §1.3" is the operator's own waiver of the review GOVERNANCE §1.3 asks for, and it is needed: no independent review of this text exists. Council t_0003 read an earlier draft with its context cut, and its red-team seat (the one seat of a second family) gave no readable final critique; Panel t_0004 read the text whole, with a red-team seat, on one model family only, the family that wrote the spec, so it does not count as an independent review and cannot be cited in reviewed_by. The findings of both, and of the Panel's recheck, are applied (section 9).
